Build farm news

The community build farm compiles every package for the distribution. This update describes the repairs, the new power supply, and the plan for the next quarter of maintenance work.

Volunteers worked for three weekends to restore service. They replaced the damaged racks and moved the storage to a new room with better ventilation and a dedicated circuit.

  • Sponsored by Acme Foundation

    We repaired the public build farm after the server room flooded during the storm. The machines now run on renewable power, and the raised floor keeps the storage disks and network equipment above the water line.

  • Sponsored by Acme Foundation

    The mirror network gained two new hosts in Europe this month after a long search for donated hardware, and both hosts now serve the full archive with nightly synchronization from the primary site.
